headline: How much is the euro? Euro to zloty rate PLN/EUR 23.11.2026
summary: Explorers are stepping up the search for Papua New Guinea's next major oil and gas discovery, citing a landmark deepwater well and a proven onshore gas district.
why: Exploration partnerships share the cost and risk of drilling, and new discoveries can underpin future LNG export projects and government revenue.
